This preview adds the settings window, offline portable USB mode, loopback-only port forwarding and SSH, shared-folder home links, diagnostics, and `try-omarchy-export` for moving a trial setup to a real install.

New and reset guests use Omarchy 4.0.2 and include yay, the base-devel toolchain, Omarchy's Neovim setup, clang, screen recording, and the tools used by Omarchy's menus and keybindings.

It also fixes failed-update rollback, existing-disk upgrades, full-disk handling, startup on systems that reject nested virtualization, idle CPU use, QEMU audio underruns, and notification behavior and privacy. Existing writable guests keep their installed system and user data.
